non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: The 95/5 blend remains best at 0.56078860898138 aggregate accuracy and 0.560358959023249 aggregate macro F1. The 92.5/7.5 blend reached 0.5602409638554217 accuracy and 0.5598149536740639 macro F1, confirming diminishing returns from nearby weight changes. A distinct 4096-token encoder-only cross-entropy run with learning rate 1.5e-5 and label smoothing 0.005 may improve robustness over the weaker 2.5e-5 configuration. This hypothesis uses clean-validation and training evidence, not test labels.
